name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three static HTTPS sites, including virtual hosts, TLS certificates, security headers, logging, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Provisions and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and selected replication-related configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI application, configures its virtual environment and database credentials, and runs it through a systemd Uvicorn service.
